# Quokka AI

> A clean, privacy-first AI chat interface powered by Groq and Llama 3.3 70B.

## Overview

Quokka AI is a free, private AI chat web app built by Arcbase. Conversations are stored locally in your browser. No account required.

- **URL**: https://ai.libreapps.xyz
- **Type**: Web Application
- **Category**: Productivity / AI Assistant
- **Price**: Free

## Key Features

- Private AI chat with local browser storage
- No account or sign-up required
- Light and dark themes
- Saved chat history (can be disabled for session-only mode)
- Code block rendering with copy button
- Markdown support in AI responses
- Optional approximate location context (language + timezone only)
- Fast and reasoning response modes
- Keyboard shortcuts for power users

## Technology

- **Frontend**: React + Vite + TypeScript
- **AI Model**: Llama 3.1 70B Versatile via Groq
- **Hosting**: Vercel
- **Privacy**: Zero data retention for chats; localStorage for history
